url.title: Source
url.description: File URL, storeId/key for a key-value store record, or the generated sample's name.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: url, kv (key-value store record) or sample (generated test clip).

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: From the Content-Disposition header, the URL path or the record key.

inputContainer.title: Input container
inputContainer.description: Container FFprobe detected, e.g. mov,mp4,m4a,3gp,3g2,mj2 or matroska,webm.

inputVideoCodec.title: Input video codec
inputVideoCodec.description: e.g. h264, hevc, vp9, av1, mpeg4; null for audio-only files.

inputAudioCodec.title: Input audio codec
inputAudioCodec.description: e.g. aac, mp3, opus, pcm_s16le; null when the file has no audio.

inputDurationSeconds.title: Input duration (s)
inputDurationSeconds.description: Length of the input file in seconds.

inputBitrate.title: Input bitrate (bit/s)
inputBitrate.description: Overall bitrate of the input file.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: mp4, webm, mp3, m4a or wav.

outputVideoCodec.title: Output video codec
outputVideoCodec.description: h264 (MP4) or vp9 (WebM); null for audio outputs and failures.

outputAudioCodec.title: Output audio codec
outputAudioCodec.description: aac, opus, mp3 or pcm_s16le; null when muted or silent.

outputDurationSeconds.title: Output duration (s)
outputDurationSeconds.description: Length of the output in seconds.

outputBitrate.title: Output bitrate (bit/s)
outputBitrate.description: Overall bitrate of the output file.

savedPercent.title: Saved (%)
savedPercent.description: How much smaller the output is than the input, in percent (negative if larger).

crf.title: CRF
crf.description: Video quality used; null in target-size mode and for audio outputs.

outputKey.title: Output key
outputKey.description: Record key of the converted file in the run's key-value store.

outputUrl.title: Converted file
outputUrl.description: Link to the converted file in the run's key-value store.

chargedEvent.title: Charged event
chargedEvent.description: audio-minute, video-480p-minute, video-720p-minute or video-1080p-minute; null for failures, which are free.

chargedMinutes.title: Charged minutes
chargedMinutes.description: Started minutes of output billed (with a 1-second grace); null for failures.

processingSeconds.title: Processing time (s)
processingSeconds.description: Wall time to probe, convert and save the file.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Notes such as a silent input, a target size that could not be reached, or an input above 1080p billed as 1080p.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the file failed (not billed), or null on success.

convertedAt.title: Converted at
convertedAt.description: When the file was processed (ISO 8601 UTC).
